paper_title: Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models
caption: GPT-4o vs. Fine-tuned LLaMA & Mistral in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini
model_annotation: This pie chart represents the win rates of four distinct large language models – GPT-4o, GPT-4o, Mistral, and LLaMA – across a series of evaluations of empathetic responses as judged by Gemini. The chart consists of five slices, each representing a different model, and visually ordered from largest to smallest. The largest slice, colored blue, represents GPT-4o with a win rate of approximately 19.6%, followed by another blue slice indicating GPT-4o with a win rate of 12.0%. A red slice labeled Mistral occupies roughly 88.0% of the remaining area, and two gray slices represent LLaMA and GPT-4o, each with approximately 80.4% of the remaining space, respectively.  The chart includes percentage labels displayed directly within each slice, and a central title reads “Win rate (%)”.
